summary: Globant S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 20, 2026 disclosing the appointment of Fernando Matzkin as Chief Operating Officer, effective that date. Matzkin had served as Chief Revenue Officer since July 2025 and joined the company in 2009, previously holding roles including Chief Business Officer and General Manager for Europe (2022–July 2025), Chief Business Officer for North America (2020–2022), and GM of the U.S. East Region (2019–2020). No price, stake, or transaction terms were stated; no advisor or board recommendation is referenced. The filing is a routine internal promotion rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
